info.name: LumenFlow Contract API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the LumenFlow Soroban smart contract on Stellar. Covers all contract function categories: admin, merchant management, payment processing, refunds, and multi-signature payments.

## Setup
1. Import this collection into Postman v10+.
2. Create an environment and set the variables listed below.
3. Run requests in order within each folder, or use individual requests as needed.

## Environment Variables
| Variable | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `RPC_URL` | Soroban RPC endpoint | `https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org` |
| `NETWORK_PASSPHRASE` | Stellar network passphrase | `Test SDF Network ; September 2015` |
| `CONTRACT_ID` | Deployed LumenFlow contract ID | `CAAAA...` |
| `ADMIN_ADDRESS` | Admin Stellar address | `GAAA...` |
| `ADMIN_SECRET` | Admin secret key | `SAAA...` |
| `MERCHANT_ADDRESS` | Merchant Stellar address | `GBBB...` |
| `MERCHANT_SECRET` | Merchant secret key | `SBBB...` |
| `PAYER_ADDRESS` | Payer Stellar address | `GCCC...` |
| `PAYER_SECRET` | Payer secret key | `SCCC...` |
| `TOKEN_ADDRESS` | SAC token contract address | `CDDD...` |
| `ORDER_ID` | Example order ID | `ORDER_001` |
| `REFUND_ID` | Example refund ID | `REFUND_001` |
| `PAYMENT_ID` | Example multisig payment ID | `MS_001` |

item.name: Admin
item.description: Admin-only operations: initialise the contract, configure thresholds, pause/unpause, cleanup and archive payments, and query global statistics.

request.description:
One-time initialisation. Sets the contract admin. Must be called before any other admin functions.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $ADMIN_SECRET \
  --rpc-url $RPC_URL \
  --network-passphrase "$NETWORK_PASSPHRASE" \
  -- set_admin \
  --admin $ADMIN_ADDRESS
```

**Expected response:** `null` (void, no return value)

**Errors:** `AlreadyInitialized` if admin is already set.

Sets how long (in seconds) a payment record is retained before it becomes eligible for cleanup.

Default: `2592000` (30 days). Example value `7776000` = 90 days.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $ADMIN_SECRET \
  -- set_payment_cleanup_period \
  --admin $ADMIN_ADDRESS \
  --period 7776000
```

**Expected response:** `null`

**Errors:** `Unauthorized` if caller is not admin.

Deletes all payment records older than `CleanupPeriod` seconds. Also removes corresponding entries from `MerchantPayments` and `PayerPayments` indexes. Idempotent — safe to call multiple times.

See [docs/storage-schema.md](storage-schema.md) for full details on which keys are deleted.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $ADMIN_SECRET \
  -- cleanup_expired_payments \
  --admin $ADMIN_ADDRESS
```

**Expected response:** `null`

**Errors:** `Unauthorized`, `NotInitialized`

Explicitly removes a single payment record regardless of age. Use for manual archiving.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $ADMIN_SECRET \
  -- archive_payment_record \
  --admin $ADMIN_ADDRESS \
  --order_id "$ORDER_ID"
```

**Expected response:** `null`

**Errors:** `Unauthorized`, `PaymentNotFound`

Returns aggregate payment and refund statistics. Optionally filter by date range.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $ADMIN_SECRET \
  -- get_global_payment_stats \
  --admin $ADMIN_ADDRESS \
  --date_start null \
  --date_end null
```

**Expected response:**
```json
{
  "total_payments": 142,
  "total_volume": 5832000,
  "total_refunds": 8,
  "total_refund_volume": 120000,
  "active_merchants": 17
}
```

**Errors:** `Unauthorized`

item.name: Merchant Management
item.description: Register merchants, update profiles, deactivate accounts, and query merchant data.

request.description:
Registers a new merchant profile. The merchant_address must sign the transaction.

**Categories:** `Retail` | `Food` | `Services` | `Digital` | `Other`

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $MERCHANT_SECRET \
  -- register_merchant \
  --merchant_address $MERCHANT_ADDRESS \
  --name "Acme Store" \
  --description "Online retailer" \
  --contact_info "contact@acme.com" \
  --category Retail
```

**Expected response:** `null`

**Errors:** `AlreadyRegistered`, `InvalidInput` (empty name/description)

Retrieves a merchant profile. Any caller may read merchant data.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $CALLER_SECRET \
  -- get_merchant \
  --merchant_address $MERCHANT_ADDRESS
```

**Expected response:**
```json
{
  "address": "GBBB...",
  "name": "Acme Store",
  "description": "Online retailer",
  "contact_info": "contact@acme.com",
  "category": "Retail",
  "active": true,
  "verified": false,
  "registered_at": 1706745600,
  "total_received": 5832000
}
```

**Errors:** `MerchantNotFound`

Returns `true` if the address has a registered merchant profile, `false` otherwise.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $CALLER_SECRET \
  -- is_registered \
  --address $MERCHANT_ADDRESS
```

**Expected response:** `true` or `false`

Sets the merchant's `active` flag to `false`. Admin only. The merchant record is retained; payments to a deactivated merchant are rejected.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $ADMIN_SECRET \
  -- deactivate_merchant \
  --admin $ADMIN_ADDRESS \
  --merchant_address $MERCHANT_ADDRESS
```

**Expected response:** `null`

**Errors:** `Unauthorized`, `MerchantNotFound`

item.name: Payment Processing
item.description: Process single and batch payments, query payment records, and manage payment history.

request.description:
Processes a single payment verified by an Ed25519 merchant signature.

The `signature` is computed off-chain by the merchant over:
`SHA-256(order_id || payer || merchant_address || token_address || amount || memo)`

See [docs/signature-format.md](signature-format.md) for the canonical byte layout and SDK helpers.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $PAYER_SECRET \
  -- process_payment_with_signature \
  --payer $PAYER_ADDRESS \
  --order_id "ORDER_001" \
  --merchant_address $MERCHANT_ADDRESS \
  --token_address $TOKEN_ADDRESS \
  --amount 5000 \
  --memo "Invoice #001" \
  --signature <ed25519-sig-bytes> \
  --merchant_public_key <ed25519-pubkey-bytes>
```

**Expected response:** `null`

**Errors:** `InvalidSignature`, `DuplicateOrderId`, `MerchantNotFound`, `MerchantInactive`, `InsufficientBalance`

Retrieves a single payment record by order ID. Caller must be the payer, merchant, or admin.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $CALLER_SECRET \
  -- get_payment_by_id \
  --caller $CALLER_ADDRESS \
  --order_id "ORDER_001"
```

**Expected response:**
```json
{
  "order_id": "ORDER_001",
  "merchant_address": "GBBB...",
  "payer": "GCCC...",
  "token": "CDDD...",
  "amount": 5000,
  "status": "Completed",
  "paid_at": 1706745600,
  "refunded_amount": 0,
  "memo": "Invoice #001"
}
```

**Errors:** `PaymentNotFound`, `Unauthorized`

Returns a paginated, filtered, and sorted list of payments for a merchant. Uses cursor-based pagination (see ADR-002).

**Sort fields:** `Date` | `Amount`
**Sort orders:** `Ascending` | `Descending`
**Max page size:** 100
**Filter fields:** `date_start`, `date_end`, `amount_min`, `amount_max`, `token`, `status`

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $MERCHANT_SECRET \
  -- get_merchant_payment_history \
  --merchant $MERCHANT_ADDRESS \
  --cursor null \
  --limit 10 \
  --filter null \
  --sort_field Date \
  --sort_order Descending
```

**Expected response:**
```json
{
  "payments": [ { "order_id": "ORDER_001", ... } ],
  "next_cursor": "ORDER_001",
  "total": 42
}
```

Returns a paginated payment history for a payer, with optional amount/status/date filters.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $PAYER_SECRET \
  -- get_payer_payment_history \
  --payer $PAYER_ADDRESS \
  --cursor null \
  --limit 10 \
  --filter '{"amount_min":100,"amount_max":5000,"status":"Any"}' \
  --sort_field Amount \
  --sort_order Ascending
```

**Status filter values:** `Any` | `Completed` | `PartiallyRefunded` | `FullyRefunded`

item.name: Refunds
item.description: Full refund lifecycle: initiate → approve/reject → execute. See docs/refund-lifecycle.md for the state diagram.

request.description:
Opens a refund request for an existing payment. Caller must be the payer or merchant.

**Refund rules:**
- Window: 30 days from `paid_at`
- Partial refunds allowed; cumulative total cannot exceed original payment amount
- Max refunds per order: `MaxRefundsPerOrder` (default 5)

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $CALLER_SECRET \
  -- initiate_refund \
  --caller $CALLER_ADDRESS \
  --refund_id "REFUND_001" \
  --order_id "ORDER_001" \
  --amount 500 \
  --reason "Customer request"
```

**Expected response:** `null`

**Errors:** `Unauthorized`, `PaymentNotFound`, `RefundWindowExpired`, `RefundLimitExceeded`, `AmountExceedsPayment`

Approves a pending refund. Caller must be the merchant or admin.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $MERCHANT_SECRET \
  -- approve_refund \
  --caller $MERCHANT_ADDRESS \
  --refund_id "REFUND_001"
```

**Expected response:** `null`

**Errors:** `Unauthorized`, `RefundNotFound`, `InvalidRefundStatus` (must be Pending)

Rejects a pending refund. Caller must be the merchant or admin.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $MERCHANT_SECRET \
  -- reject_refund \
  --caller $MERCHANT_ADDRESS \
  --refund_id "REFUND_001"
```

**Expected response:** `null`

**Errors:** `Unauthorized`, `RefundNotFound`, `InvalidRefundStatus` (must be Pending)

Executes an approved refund, transferring tokens from merchant back to payer. Caller must be the merchant (who signs the token transfer).

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $MERCHANT_SECRET \
  -- execute_refund \
  --refund_id "REFUND_001"
```

**Expected response:** `null`

**Errors:** `Unauthorized`, `RefundNotFound`, `InvalidRefundStatus` (must be Approved), `InsufficientBalance`

Returns the current state of a refund record.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $CALLER_SECRET \
  -- get_refund \
  --refund_id "REFUND_001"
```

**Expected response:**
```json
{
  "refund_id": "REFUND_001",
  "order_id": "ORDER_001",
  "initiator": "GCCC...",
  "amount": 500,
  "reason": "Customer request",
  "status": "Approved",
  "created_at": 1706832000
}
```

**Status values:** `Pending` | `Approved` | `Rejected` | `Completed` | `Disputed`

**Errors:** `RefundNotFound`

item.name: Multi-Signature Payments
item.description: Initiate, sign, and execute multi-signature payments that require threshold approvals from a defined signer set.

request.description:
Creates a new multi-signature payment requiring `required_signatures` out of the listed `signers` to approve before execution.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $INITIATOR_SECRET \
  -- initiate_multisig_payment \
  --initiator $INITIATOR_ADDRESS \
  --payment_id "MS_001" \
  --merchant_address $MERCHANT_ADDRESS \
  --token_address $TOKEN_ADDRESS \
  --amount 5000 \
  --signers '["GSIGNER1...","GSIGNER2..."]' \
  --required_signatures 2
```

**Expected response:** `null`

**Errors:** `DuplicatePaymentId`, `InvalidInput` (required_signatures > signers count), `MerchantNotFound`

Adds a signature from one of the authorised signers. Once `required_signatures` threshold is met, the payment is ready to execute.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $SIGNER_SECRET \
  -- sign_multisig_payment \
  --signer $SIGNER_ADDRESS \
  --payment_id "MS_001" \
  --signature <ed25519-sig-bytes>
```

**Expected response:** `null`

**Errors:** `PaymentNotFound`, `Unauthorized` (signer not in list), `AlreadySigned`, `PaymentAlreadyExecuted`

Executes the multisig payment once the required signature threshold has been met. The payer triggers the final token transfer.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $PAYER_SECRET \
  -- execute_multisig_payment \
  --payer $PAYER_ADDRESS \
  --payment_id "MS_001"
```

**Expected response:** `null`

**Errors:** `PaymentNotFound`, `ThresholdNotMet` (not enough signatures yet), `PaymentAlreadyExecuted`, `InsufficientBalance`

Returns the current state of a multisig payment, including collected signatures and execution status.

**CLI equivalent:**
```bash
stellar contract invoke \
  --id $CONTRACT_ID \
  --source-account $CALLER_SECRET \
  -- get_multisig_payment \
  --payment_id "MS_001"
```

**Expected response:**
```json
{
  "payment_id": "MS_001",
  "merchant_address": "GBBB...",
  "token": "CDDD...",
  "amount": 5000,
  "required_signatures": 2,
  "signers": ["GSIGNER1...", "GSIGNER2..."],
  "signatures": ["<sig1>"],
  "executed": false,
  "created_at": 1706832000
}
```

**Errors:** `PaymentNotFound`
